Our proprietary sizing matrix is engineered specifically for Oahu's micro-climates. Use it to determinethe precise BTU capacity required for your space, ensuring maximum efficiency, superior dehumidification, and long-term equipment durability. Don’t guess with your comfort—deploy the correct infrastructure.

climate.title: WHY HAWAII'S CLIMATE
climate.description_p1: Oahu's high humidity and constant exposure to saline trade winds create a "perfect storm" for window A/C units. Unlike drier climates, Honolulu's air causes rapid condensation buildup within the internal casing of window units, which often goes unnoticed behind the front grill.
climate.description_p2_prefix: This moisture, combined with indoor dust, creates a fertile breeding ground for
climate.description_p2_suffix: and bacteria. Without regular professional sanitization, your window unit becomes a distribution system for allergens, causing "Sick Building Syndrome" symptoms like headaches, fatigue, andrespiratory distress.
climate.description_p3_prefix: Furthermore, salt-air corrosion eats away at sensitive aluminum fins and copper tubing. Our deep cleaning process includes a specialized
climate.description_p3_suffix: that neutralizes salt deposits, potentially extending your unit's lifespan by 3-5 years.

process.title: OUR PROPRIETARY 25-POINT
process.subtitle: Medical-Grade Restoration for Residential Window Units
process.step1_description: We use a non-toxic, hospital-grade antimicrobial solution forced through both evaporator and condenser coils at precise pressure to dissolve biofilm and mold roots that retail sprays can't reach.

step2.title: BLOWER WHEEL REBALANCING
step2.desc: Removing buildup from fan blades to eliminate vibrations and motor strain.

step3.title: DRAIN CHANNEL FLUSH
step3.desc: Clearing standing water paths to prevent rust and overflow leaks.

step4.title: FIN COMBING
step4.desc: Precision alignment of aluminum fins for maximum thermodynamic exchange.

step5.title: DELTA T TESTING
step5.desc: Digital verification of intake vs. output temps to confirm peak delta performance.

items.q: How often should I have my window A/C professionally cleaned in Oahu?
items.a: Due to our high humidity and salt-air concentration, we recommend a deep clinical sanitization every 6-12 months for primary living spaces to prevent mold buildup and corrosion.

items.q: Does dirty window A/C impact electricity bills?
items.a: Yes. Clogged coils force the compressor to work 30-50% harder to achieve the same cooling effect, leading to significantly higher MECO/HECO bills and premature motor failure.

items.q: Can I just use a spray bottle from the hardware store?
items.a: Hardware store sprays only treat the surface. Our process involves full teardown and internal decontamination of the blower wheel and drain pan where 90% of mold actually resides.

hero.title: Deep Cleaning
hero.description: This complete service covers every part of a window unit. Deep cleaning removes hidden dirt and mold to keep the air fresh. A clean machine runs better and feels like new again.

phases.title: Phase 1: Removal and Disassembly
phases.description: Safe removal from the window casing starts the process. Technicians take off the metal shell to reach the internal coils and fan. Every wire stays covered or disconnected to keep the electrical parts dry and safe.

phases.title: Phase 2: Deep Cleaning
phases.description: A specialized soap breaks down stubborn grease and dirt on the coils. Scrubbing the fan assembly gets rid of dust and mold. Fresh water and a germ-killing spray leave the entire unit clean and healthy.

phases.title: Phase 3: Drainage and Clearing
phases.description: Thoroughly cleaning the blower wheel, compressor, motor, and evaporator coil restores peak efficiency. Clear drain holes prevent water from leaking into the home, while cleaning the bottom pan removes all hidden dirt and clogs.

phases.title: Phase 4: Testing and Re-Install
phases.description: Every part gets dried before the unit goes back together. A full test makes sure the fan and drains work perfectly. The AC then returns to the window for a secure fit.
